import openpyxl

src = wb['Imported Data']
dst = wb['Items Older than 30 days']

rows = list(range(2,15))
maxd = max(src.cell(r,5).value for r in rows)
threshold = maxd - timedelta(days=30)

# copy header
for c in range(1,10):
    dst.cell(1,c).value = src.cell(1,c).value
    dst.cell(1,c).number_format = src.cell(1,c).number_format

# qualifying rows: date > 30 days older than max => date < threshold
out = 2
for r in rows:
    if src.cell(r,5).value < threshold:
        for c in range(1,10):
            dst.cell(out,c).value = src.cell(r,c).value
            dst.cell(out,c).number_format = src.cell(r,c).number_format

# delete column Z in sheet 2

print('saved')
